main.description: Salesforce-equivalent Contact: a natural person associated with an Account. This Tier 1 record carries ONLY a hashed email index and a DID reference. Raw email / phone / full name live in Tier 3 Preferences (com.etzhayyim.apps.opensaas.salesforce.contactPrivate) per ADR-0018. Raw PII in free-text fields is field-encrypted with signal:v1: prefix when written.

accountDid.description: owning Account record AT URI or DID

personDid.description: natural-person DID (did:plc) if the contact has their own identity on the network

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex of lowercased email — index only, NOT reversible

displayLabel.description: non-PII display (e.g. 'CTO at ACME') — DO NOT put full name here
